16 PARTS / RASTER
HOW IT FITS TOGETHER

Assets + joints + a clock.

The shoulder carries the forearm. The elbow carries the hand. Move a parent joint and its children stay attached. Claude changes joint angles to create new actions. A scroll timeline can become the clock.

const buddy = await mountBuddy(element);

// Move independently, with a time value.
buddy.poseAt('run', seconds);

// Or design a new pose.
buddy.setPose({
  'arm-right': -140,
  'elbow-right': -20,
  head: -6
});
